description: ALFRED revision history: every date FRED published a new vintage (initial release or a later revision) of a series. Use before fred_revisions to see which dates have a distinct vintage, or pass one of these dates as `as_of`/`realtime_start`+`realtime_end` to fred_get_series to get the data as it stood on that date.

limit.description: Max vintage dates to return (1-10000, default 100)

sort_order.description: asc = oldest vintage first, desc = newest vintage first (default desc)

name: fred_vintage_dates
